guideline: Pairwise comparison between EARL and baseline responses

Metrics: We adopted two widely used metrics, Appropriateness and Informativeness as proposed in . Appropriateness measures the quality of the generated response at the content level (whether the response is appropriate in relevance, coherence, and adequacy). Informativeness measures the quality of the generated response at the knowledge level (whether the response provides new information and relevant knowledge in response to the context).
Pairwise comparison where annotators choose the preferred response based on Appropriateness (content relevance, coherence, adequacy) and Informativeness (knowledge contribution).
